messages.subject: UTF-8 text encoding?
parts:
Dear Ian,

I really like Deducer: it is a quite helpful tool for using R in a friendly way. Congratulations for your great work.

I wonder if Deducer can be configured with text encoding UTF-8 in order to allow particular Spanish characters to be handled in labels, filenames, etc. Symbols like ó, ñ, are not displayed properly. In fact, I spent a lot of time figuring out that Deducer (i.e. R) was not able to open a folder because it had an "ñ" in its name! :-( 

Thanks.

Jorge Navarro
Departamento de Ecologia
Universidad Autonoma de Yucatan
Merida, Yucatan, México
